description: OCC Road Verge Nature Reserve is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Oxfordshire County Council. Road Verge Nature Reserves were initally identifed in 1991. From an initial selection of 24 sites additional locations have been added as these have come to our attention. These initial 24 sites include data on species composition. The current list of mapped sites numbers 32. The later RVNRs do not yet have associated species data. Coverage: Oxfordshire County Council. The portal files it under the publisher Oxfordshire County Council. The portal shows 2026-07-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
